doc: If `l₁` is a subsequence of `l₂`, then `a :: l₁` is a subsequence of `a :: l₂`.
name: List.Sublist.cons₂
typeText:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {l₁ l₂ : List.{u_1} α} (a : α),
  List.Sublist.{u_1} l₁ l₂ → List.Sublist.{u_1} (List.cons.{u_1} a l₁) (List.cons.{u_1} a l₂)

source.code:
/-- If `l₁` is a subsequence of `l₂`, then `a :: l₁` is a subsequence of `a :: l₂`. -/
  | cons₂ a : Sublist l₁ l₂ → Sublist (a :: l₁) (a :: l₂)
